system.description:
Deal [(SR+3)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Fate 1 & Effect): This skill changes to [Range: 2 Sq.] After the current Main Process ends, you [Teleport] to the same square as the target.

A special skill that allows him to soar like a flying dragon and unleash a powerful jumping kick. By applying more force, you can jump into and hit enemies farther away.
